title: Space Platform Hub
description: The control center of a space platform.

request_missing_construction_materials.title: Request Missing Construction Materials
request_missing_construction_materials.description: Whether or not this space platform should automatically request deliveries to satisfy it's own construction demands.

providing_to_other_platforms.title: Provide to Other Platforms
providing_to_other_platforms.description: Whether or not this space platform should automatically request deliveries to satisfy it's own construction demands.

set_requests.title: Set Requests
set_requests.description: Whether or not this space platform should set it's requests dynamically via its circuit network input wires.

read_contents.description: Whether or not this hub should broadcast the contents of it's inventory to a connected circuit network.

send_to_platform.description: Whether or not the hub should use signals given to it when determining it's schedule.

read_moving_from.description: Whether or not the hub should output a signal with a value of 1 representing the planet being travelled away from.

read_moving_to.description: Whether or not the hub should output a signal with a value of 2 representing the planet being travelled to.

read_speed.description: Whether or not the hub should output it's current speed. The signal type to output is determined by `speed_signal`.

speed_signal.description: The signal to output this platforms current speed on. Has no effect unless `read_speed` is `true`.

read_damage_taken.description: Whether or not the hub should output the amount of damage sustained by the platform since it started travelling. The signal type to output is determined by `damage_taken_signal`.

damage_taken_signal.description: The signal to output the amount of damage taken on. Has no effect unless `read_damage_taken` is `true`.
